title: Pointwise left Kan extension of coherent space-valued diagrams
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories, coherent diagrams, functor categories and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the infinity category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ of $\mathcal W$-small spaces of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Let $A,B$ be $\mathcal W$-small quasicategories and $v:A\to B$ a coherent functor. Functor categories are formed in a further universe. For $b\in B$, let $(v\downarrow b)$ be the coherent comma category with objects $(a,\alpha:v(a)\to b)$, commuting triangles, and their higher simplices; explicitly it is
$$A\times_{B,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,B)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,B}\{b\}.$$
For a coherent $F:A\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ there exist a coherent $v_!F:B\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ and a transformation $\eta_F:F\to(v_!F)v$ such that, for every coherent $G:B\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$, the map
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal S_{\mathcal W})}(v_!F,G)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(A,\mathcal S_{\mathcal W})}(F,Gv),\qquad \theta\longmapsto(\theta v)\eta_F$$
is an equivalence of spaces, natural in $G$. For every $b$, the cocone with components $F(a)\xrightarrow{\eta_{F,a}}(v_!F)(v(a))\xrightarrow{(v_!F)(\alpha)}(v_!F)(b)$ is colimiting on the diagram $(v\downarrow b)\to A\xrightarrow{F}\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$. These are coherent cocones on the entire comma category. In particular, if $F=\Delta_A*$ and $G=\Delta_B*$ for the one-point space $*$, the mate $e:v_!\Delta_A*\to\Delta_B*$ of the identity $\Delta_A*\to\Delta_A*$ has, at $b$, the map from this comma-indexed colimit of the constant one-point diagram induced by its identity cocone.

source.place: HTT (April 9, 2017), Definition 4.3.2.2, Lemma 4.3.2.13, Proposition 4.3.2.15, Definition 4.3.3.2 and Proposition 4.3.3.7; arbitrary-functor comma form of pointwise left Kan extension. Read online, not archived in literature/. No matching Stacks tag: the assertion is quasicategorical, not ordinary Kan extension.
